title: DAY OF THE TENTACLE
subtitle: LucasArts, 1993 · the non-interactive demo, with its speech, on ScummVM 0.10.0 (2007)
argsHint: -p<dir> where the game is, then its id (0.10.0's: monkey, monkey2, atlantis, tentacle, samnmax, queen...; it upgrades 0.6.1's monkeyEGA and the like). Other switches: -g<scaler> (1x, 2x, 3x, 2xsai, super2xsai, supereagle, advmame2x, advmame3x, hq2x, hq3x, tv2x, dotmatrix), -f full screen, -m<volume> music, -s<volume> effects, -n subtitles (off by default; with speech, the text is shown too), -z the games each engine knows.
fpsNote: A FALLBACK cap only: the engine paces itself on the SDL clock.

needsData.hint: dott-dos-ni-demo-en.zip as the ScummVM project distributes it (downloads.scummvm.org/frs/demos/scumm/), unpacked in the page

_why: A SCUMM v6 game on the same build. Its speech file is left out: ScummVM 0.6.1 asserts on it (sound/voc.cpp:125), natively as here. Held to a native g++ build frame by frame (gate-scummvm).
_shipped: The game of scummvm-dott.json, with its data the demo archive ScummVM hosts, passed on whole and unpacked in the page: what the static export ships (tools/site-programs.json). It runs on ScummVM 0.10.0, whose SCUMM engine plays the demos' speech (MONSTER.SOU), on which 0.6.1 asserts.
